scripts.experiment: npm run build && node scripts/experiment.mjs && node scripts/single-language.mjs && python3 scripts/verify_single.py --certify && node scripts/colored-language.mjs && python3 scripts/verify_colored.py
scripts.verify: python3 scripts/verify.py && python3 scripts/verify_single.py && python3 scripts/verify_colored.py
scripts.check: npm test && npm run experiment && python3 scripts/verify.py
scripts.experiment:en: npm run build && node scripts/single-language.mjs EN && python3 scripts/verify_single.py --language EN
scripts.experiment:de: npm run build && node scripts/single-language.mjs DE && python3 scripts/verify_single.py --certify --language DE
